text.content:
Proof you've climbed out of the gutter, if not proof you've made it.

Region: Westbrook (district H). Was: New Westbrook, 2045's Charter Hill
Controlled by: A consortium of the campus corps (Kiroshi, Dynalar, Rocklin): patrols in three different logos
The feel of it: Clean, safe and watched. Without a corporate ID, you'll be asked for one
Notable locations: Kiroshi Campus (#14), Dynalar Complex (#15), Rocklin Augmentics (#16), Red Queen's Race (#17), WorldSat Offices (#77), Colonial Studios (#78)
Danger: Corporate. SC 8 (corporate security consortium, Hardened Medium). UC 2

Militech held the security contract here in 2045. After the war the Council quietly let it lapse and handed the hill to the campus corps' consortium. The refugees of the 2020s were cleared out years ago. Mid-level corporate employees live in company housing with their families; H9 houses three campus corps at once, under three sets of rules. Service workers commute in on the Westbrook Express.

Places

  • Kiroshi Campus (#14). SC 10. Optics R&D; last year's models at a discount in the gift shop.
  • Dynalar Complex (#15). SC 10. Cyberlimbs and prosthetics. Hires test subjects.
  • Rocklin Augmentics (#16). SC 9. Cyberware manufacturing, and the only prototype clinic on the hill that takes walk-ins.
  • Red Queen's Race (#17). SC 7. A corpo bar and racing-sim lounge where junior execs make deals they'll regret.
  • WorldSat Offices (#77). SC 9. Satellite communications; their dishes see everything that moves in the Badlands.
  • Colonial Studios (#78). SC 7. An old film lot, now BD and holo production, with cheap sets for rent.

Getting There

NCART: Lincoln Blvd, Diamond St, Longshore (Star Line, Westbrook Express).

Turf

None inside. 6th Street sells protection on the west slope.

People

  • Director Ama Boateng (Exec 7). Consortium security chief: curfews, ID checks and a very good memory.
  • Lucky Pierce (Fixer 4). Sells Kiroshi and Dynalar seconds out of a van on the west slope, under 6th Street protection.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.09
